paragraphs: Rav Chanan bar Tachlifa; see Anan bar Tachlifa above. He sent Rav Yosef: “I saw a scroll written in Assyrian script in the holy tongue.” The scroll was found in Rome’s archives: “After 4291 years from the world's creation, the world will be orphaned [יתום], etc.; the Holy One, blessed be He, renews His world after four thousand or five thousand years”: Chelek, Sanhedrin 97b.
